SdReshadeShaders.description: Colour grading for SDR and HDR: SD Subtractive Saturation (lowers brightness as colours get more saturated, keeping them dense) and SD Color Density (darkens saturated colours without shifting hues or neutral tones).

UltrawideSideGlass.description: Fills ultrawide black pillarboxes with zoomed, mirrored, or frosted glass effects while preserving the centre image and HDR metadata. Supports 21:9, 32:9, and many other aspect ratios.
